data.name: Common_Ready
data.value: Ready

data.name: Barcode_NoData
data.value: There is no data for the barcode.

data.name: Barcode_DigitsOnly
data.value: This barcode accepts digits only, but the data contains '{0}'.

data.name: Barcode_Code39_BadCharShort
data.value: Code 39 cannot hold the character '{0}'.

data.name: Barcode_Code11_BadChar
data.value: Code 11 holds digits and hyphens only, but the data contains '{0}'.

data.name: Barcode_Code128_EndsWithSpecial
data.value: The data ends with '>', which starts a Code 128 special code. Add the code character after it, or remove the '>'.

data.name: Barcode_Code128_BadSpecial
data.value: '>{0}' is not a Code 128 special code. Remove it, or write >0 for a literal '>'.

data.name: Barcode_Code128_UnpairedDigit
data.value: In Code 128 subset C digits come in pairs, but a digit has no partner. Add a digit or switch subset before it.

data.name: Barcode_Code128_ShiftNeedsChar
data.value: The Code 128 shift code >4 must be followed directly by a character. Put the character right after >4.

data.name: Barcode_Code128_ShiftSubset
data.value: The Code 128 shift code >4 only works in subset A or B. Switch to one of them first.

data.name: Barcode_Code128_SpecialInSubsetC
data.value: This Code 128 special code cannot be used in subset C, which holds digit pairs only. Use >6 to switch to subset B first.

data.name: Barcode_Code128_TildeDelSubsetB
data.value: '~' and DEL exist only in subset B; start the data with >: or use >6 to switch to subset B before this code.

data.name: Barcode_Code128_LastDigitUnpaired
data.value: In Code 128 subset C digits come in pairs, but the last digit has no partner.

data.name: Barcode_Code128_SubsetCDigitsOnly
data.value: Code 128 subset C holds digits only, but the data contains {0}. Use >6 to switch to subset B first.

data.name: Barcode_Code128_NotInSubsetA
data.value: {0} cannot be written in Code 128 subset A. Use >6 to switch to subset B before it.

data.name: Barcode_Code128_NotInSubsetB
data.value: {0} cannot be written in Code 128 subset B. Use >7 to switch to subset A before it.

data.name: Barcode_Code128_ControlChar
data.value: the control character 0x{0:X2}

data.name: Barcode_Code128_Char
data.value: the character '{0}'

data.name: Barcode_Code128_UccDigitsOnly
data.value: UCC case mode (m = U) takes digits only. Remove the letters and special codes from the data.

data.name: Barcode_Code128_UccEanFormat
data.value: UCC/EAN mode (m = D) needs data like (01)12345678901231(10)LOT7: each application identifier in parentheses, then its value.

data.name: Barcode_Code128_BadAi
data.value: '({0})' is not an application identifier: it must be two to four digits.

data.name: Barcode_Code128_AiNoValue
data.value: The application identifier ({0}) has no value.

data.name: Barcode_Code39_StarInData
data.value: Code 39 uses '*' as its start and stop mark, so it cannot be part of the data.

data.name: Barcode_Code39_BadChar
data.value: Code 39 cannot hold the character '{0}'. It takes digits, capital letters and - . space $ / + %; lowercase letters and other symbols are written as two-character pairs, for example +A for a.

data.name: Barcode_Code93_BadChar
data.value: Code 93 cannot hold the character '{0}'. Digits, capital letters and - . space $ / + % are allowed; other characters are written with the shift characters & ' ( ) followed by a capital letter.

data.name: Barcode_DataMatrix_EndsWithEscape
data.value: The data ends with the Data Matrix escape character '{0}'. Write it twice ({0}{0}) for the character itself, or remove it.

data.name: Barcode_DataMatrix_EscapeDigits
data.value: The Data Matrix escape {0}d must be followed by three digits from 000 to 255.

data.name: Barcode_DataMatrix_EscapeUnsupported
data.value: The Data Matrix escape '{0}{1}' is not supported yet (structured append, FNC3, code pages and PAD are planned for a later release). Remove it to preview the rest of the data.

data.name: Barcode_DataMatrix_Rectangular
data.value: rectangular

data.name: Barcode_DataMatrix_Square
data.value: square

data.name: Barcode_DataMatrix_Rows
data.value: {0} rows

data.name: Barcode_DataMatrix_Columns
data.value: {0} columns

data.name: Barcode_DataMatrix_AutoRows
data.value: automatic rows

data.name: Barcode_DataMatrix_AutoColumns
data.value: automatic columns

data.name: Barcode_DataMatrix_And
data.value: and

data.name: Barcode_DataMatrix_SizeTooLarge
data.value: The requested {0} is more than the largest {1} Data Matrix symbol ({2} x {3}) has. Ask for a smaller size, or leave rows and columns empty for the automatic size.

data.name: Barcode_DataMatrix_DoesNotFitForced
data.value: The data does not fit the requested {0} x {1} Data Matrix symbol (it holds {2} codewords, the data needs {3}); the printer prints no symbol in this case. Ask for a larger size, or leave rows and columns empty for the automatic size.

data.name: Barcode_DataMatrix_TooLongRectangular
data.value: The data is too long for a rectangular Data Matrix symbol (the largest, 16 x 48, holds about 49 letters or 98 digits). Shorten the data or use the square shape.

data.name: Barcode_DataMatrix_TooLong
data.value: The data is too long for a Data Matrix symbol (the largest square symbol holds about 1550 letters or 3100 digits). Shorten the data.

data.name: Barcode_DataMatrix_NoQuality
data.value: No quality was given, so the printer uses its default 0: an older ECC 000 symbol that many scanners cannot read. LabelScope draws it as ECC 200 instead. Add 200 as the third parameter (for example ^BXN,5,200) to get the recommended type.

data.name: Barcode_DataMatrix_OldQuality
data.value: Quality {0} is an older ECC 000 to 140 symbol that many scanners cannot read; LabelScope draws it as ECC 200 instead, so the printed pattern differs. Use quality 200 for the recommended type.

data.name: Barcode_DataMatrix_UnknownQuality
data.value: Quality '{0}' is not one of the documented values 0, 50, 80, 100, 140 or 200; the symbol is drawn as ECC 200. Use 200 for the recommended Data Matrix type.

data.name: Barcode_DataMatrix_SizeIgnored
data.value: The requested rows and columns were ignored and the automatic size was used.

data.name: Barcode_DataMatrix_SizeRounded
data.value: The requested size ({0} by {1}) is not a Data Matrix size; the next larger size, {2} x {3}, was drawn.

data.name: Barcode_UpcE_NoShortForm
data.value: This UPC-E number cannot be written in the short form: the manufacturer and product numbers do not follow the zero-suppression rules.

data.name: Barcode_UpcE_Length
data.value: UPC-E needs 10 digits (5 manufacturer + 5 product) or the 6 digit short form.

data.name: Barcode_Codabar_StartStop
data.value: The Codabar start and stop characters must be A, B, C or D.

data.name: Barcode_Codabar_BadChar
data.value: Codabar cannot hold the character '{0}'. It takes digits and - $ : / . +; the start and stop letters are set with the k and l parameters.

data.name: Barcode_Msi_BadCheck
data.value: The MSI check digit option '{0}' is not valid. Use A, B, C or D.

data.name: Barcode_Pdf417_DoesNotFitSize
data.value: The data does not fit a PDF417 symbol of {0} columns x {1} rows at security level {2}; the printer prints no symbol in this case. Ask for more columns or rows, lower the security level, or shorten the data.

data.name: Barcode_Pdf417_DoesNotFitColumns
data.value: The data does not fit {0} PDF417 columns (at most {1} rows) at security level {2}; the printer prints no symbol in this case. Ask for more columns, lower the security level, or shorten the data.

data.name: Barcode_Pdf417_DoesNotFitRows
data.value: The data does not fit {0} PDF417 rows (at most {1} columns) at security level {2}; the printer prints no symbol in this case. Ask for more rows, lower the security level, or shorten the data.

data.name: Barcode_Pdf417_TooLong
data.value: The data is too long for a PDF417 symbol at security level {0}. At the default level about 2700 digits, 1800 letters or 1100 bytes (accented or other special characters) fit at most, and fewer fit at higher security levels. Shorten the data or lower the security level (the s value of ^B7).

data.name: Barcode_Pdf417_TooManyCells
data.value: {0} columns x {1} rows is more than a PDF417 symbol can hold (columns x rows must not exceed {2}); the printer prints no symbol in this case. Ask for fewer columns or rows.

data.name: Barcode_Pdf417_SecurityClamped
data.value: Security level {0} is outside 0 to {1}; level {2} was used.

data.name: Barcode_Pdf417_ColumnsInvalid
data.value: {0} columns is not valid; the number of columns was chosen automatically.

data.name: Barcode_Pdf417_ColumnsClamped
data.value: {0} columns is more than {1}; {1} columns were used.

data.name: Barcode_Pdf417_RowsInvalid
data.value: {0} rows is not valid; the number of rows was chosen automatically.

data.name: Barcode_Pdf417_RowsClamped
data.value: {0} rows is outside {1} to {2}; {3} rows were used.

data.name: Barcode_Qr_NoData
data.value: There is no data for the QR code. Add the text to encode after ^FD.

data.name: Barcode_Qr_BadMode
data.value: QR code input mode '{0}' is not supported. Use N (numeric), A (alphanumeric) or B (byte), or leave the mode out to choose automatically.

data.name: Barcode_Qr_NotNumeric
data.value: The QR code was set to numeric input, but the data contains characters that are not digits. Remove them or use automatic input.

data.name: Barcode_Qr_NotAlphanumeric
data.value: The QR code was set to alphanumeric input (digits, capital letters and space $ % * + - . / :), but the data contains other characters. Remove them or use automatic input.

data.name: Barcode_Qr_TooLong
data.value: The data is too long for a QR code (the largest symbol holds about 7000 digits, 4000 letters or 2900 bytes at the lowest error correction). Shorten the data or choose a lower error correction level.

data.name: Barcode_Qr_MixedMode
data.value: The mixed-mode (structured append) QR header is not supported yet. Remove the D header to preview the data as one symbol.

data.name: Barcode_Qr_Model1
data.value: QR model 1 is drawn as model 2. Both scan the same, but the pattern differs from a model 1 symbol.

data.name: Barcode_Qr_ManualNoMode
data.value: The QR data says the input mode is manual but no mode letter (N, A or B) follows. Add the mode letter, or use automatic input (A).

data.name: Barcode_Qr_ByteCountMissing
data.value: QR byte mode needs a four digit character count after B, for example B0005hello.

data.name: Barcode_Qr_ByteCountMismatch
data.value: The QR byte mode count says {0} characters but {1} follow. Make the four digit count after B match the data.

data.name: Barcode_Qr_Kanji
data.value: QR Kanji mode is not supported yet. Use automatic input (A) or byte mode (B) to preview the data.

data.name: Barcode_Qr_BadModeLetter
data.value: The QR input mode letter must be N, A, B or K. Fix the letter after the comma, or use automatic input (A).

data.name: Barcode_Name_UpcEanExtension
data.value: UPC/EAN extension

data.name: Barcode_Name_Postal
data.value: postal code
